candidates.change_summary: Replace the returned immutable argument index from 0x0 to 0x14 so owner() returns the address encoded at the second immutable arg instead of the first.
Return address shifted by one 32-byte slot (use arg offset 0x18 instead of 0x14), so collateral() reads a different immutable arg address.
Return address shifted earlier by 4 bytes (use arg offset 0x10 instead of 0x14), so collateral() reads a different immutable arg address.
Return zero address by returning address(0) instead of reading immutable args, changing observable collateral() value to zero-address ERC20.
Return the factory address instead of the collateral address by calling factory(), altering collateral() return.
Return owner() address cast to ERC20, so collateral() returns owner address instead of stored collateral token.
